title: Bridging the Safety Gap: A Guardrail Pipeline for Trustworthy LLM Inferences

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not evaluate bias using isolated fairness metrics; instead, it incorporates bias detection implicitly as part of a generalized 'safe vs. unsafe' binary classification task. The authors train and evaluate a Safety Detector model using safety datasets that include identity-based toxicity (specifically utilizing the Jigsaw Unintended-Bias dataset) to reject queries containing toxicity toward minority groups.
